items.headline: Hull City defeats Manchester United 2-0 in Premier League opener
items.summary: Newly promoted Hull City secured their first-ever Premier League victory over Manchester United with goals from Ajayi and Mendy in the first half.

items.headline: United face multiple injuries ahead of Hull City match
items.summary: Manchester United without Ugarte, Lisandro Martinez, de Ligt, Mainoo, Sesko, Darlow, Mount, and Heaton for the Premier League season opener.
